title: Blessing of the Animals
description:
Bring your pets, including dogs, cats, birds, rabbits, and reptiles, to Christ The King. We will meet outdoors in the pavilion. Please ensure that your dogs are leashed, and all other animals are properly contained. 

This service commemorates the feast of St. Francis of Assisi, whose life exemplified a godly delight in all creatures. At the end of the service, each animal will receive a blessing.
